offering_description.value: Operates online auctions for salvage and used vehicles, connecting insurers and other vehicle sellers with dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers and individual buyers. Also provides vehicle collection, storage and sale processing.

primary_products.value: Used and salvage vehicles purchased for resale

primary_services.value: Online vehicle auctions; vehicle remarketing; vehicle collection and transport; vehicle storage; title and sale document processing

items.detail: Insurers, vehicle dealers, fleet operators, rental companies, vehicle dismantlers, recyclers and rebuilders
Individuals selling vehicles and eligible consumers buying auction vehicles

end_markets.value: Automotive insurance; used vehicles; automotive repair and rebuilding; vehicle dismantling and recycling; fleet disposal

items.detail: Buyers and sellers pay fees associated with vehicle auction transactions
Charges for vehicle transport, storage, title processing and related services
Buyers pay membership fees for auction participation and bidding privileges
Sells vehicles purchased for its own account
Processes and remarkets vehicles from insurers and other sellers to automotive trade buyers and consumers
Operates an online marketplace connecting vehicle sellers with registered bidders
Operates physical vehicle yards for receiving, storing and releasing auction vehicles
Purchases some used and salvage vehicles for resale to vehicle buyers

geography_served.detail: Operations across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Brazil, with an international buyer base

company_size.value: Large international vehicle auction operator with an extensive yard network and a global online buyer base

specialization.detail: Vehicle auctions and remarketing, supported by vehicle transport, storage, document processing and direct vehicle purchasing

items.detail: Proprietary auction website and mobile applications
Direct relationships with insurers, fleets, dealers and other vehicle sellers
Vehicle yards provide inspection access and vehicle collection
Registered brokers help buyers access auctions subject to licensing restrictions

regulatory_exposure.detail: Vehicle auction, dealer and salvage activities require jurisdiction-specific licenses; motor vehicle authorities oversee titles and sales, while environmental agencies regulate vehicle storage and handling

notes: No website page text was provided; the description relies on model knowledge.
